units.source_text: 同时，钟声大作，孩子们大哭……狗不停地叫……

en.t: At the same time, the bells rang out, the children wailed... the dogs kept barking...

units.source_text: 每敲一下钟，他的心脏就抽紧一次，

en.t: With each toll of the bell, his heart tightened once more,

units.source_text: 毛孔张开，扑簌簌地爬出无数米粒大小的虫子。

en.t: his pores opened, and countless rice grain sized insects came rustling out.

units.source_text: 一个手电筒，像是能调节焦点，刚还以为灯光柔和，

en.t: A flashlight, as if its focus could be adjusted, had seemed only a moment ago to cast a soft light,

units.source_text: 突然变成炽热的针，直刺了过来。

en.t: but suddenly it turned into a burning needle and stabbed straight toward him.
